item.title: Denver Post, The Big Payout: Pitkin County, home to Aspen, received highest share of relief money as resort communities topped list

item.description: A group of bipartisan senators have advanced a long-overdue reform that is designed to restore fairness to America’s most vital — yet endangered — industries: news, publishing and journalism.

item.title: Boston Herald, Editorial | Local journalism is essential – new legislation would protect it
item.description: Local journalism -— essential to informed and engaged communities -— is fighting for its life.

item.description: Since 2005, the revenue produced by news publications across the country has declined by 58% and industry reform is long overdue.
